methods.name: Logit and probit as stats::glm (IRLS), with aliasing, separation and outcome-domain handling
methods.reference: stats::glm(family = binomial('logit' | 'probit')) at glm.control(epsilon = 1e-10, maxit = 100); summary.glm; tight refit at epsilon = 1e-14; R's default control for the separated case
quantities: aliased coefficients NA and the rank
separation flag and warnings (p2a's and R's default control)
limit of the identified coefficients of a quasi-separated fit
methods.tolerance: logit at epsilon 1e-10 (the MLE to 1e-13) and probit at epsilon 1e-14: coefficients 1e-8, SEs, z, logLik, AIC 1e-6, p 1e-6 + 1e-12 (validation/README.md, n = 400); the default-control probit 1e-6 against the tight MLE; quasi-separated limit coefficients 1e-6 and SEs 1e-5; near-collinear fit 1e-6

deviations.note: MleSettings defaults to max_iter 100, tolerance 1e-10 (R glm.control: 25, 1e-8); at R's default probit stops 1.6e-6 from the MLE on disc_choice_na; R's values remain settable

methods.name: Conditional (McFadden) logit with alternative-specific constants as mlogit::mlogit
methods.reference: mlogit::mlogit(chosen ~ price + catch | income), '| 0 + income', '~ price + catch', '| 0', reflevel = 'beach' | 'pier' on Fishing, re-solved by Newton's method on the analytic score and information
quantities: constants, generic and individual-specific coefficients (mlogit names)
scale-free convergence (income x 1e-6, x 1e6; iteration counts agree within one)
methods.tolerance: coefficients 1e-9, SEs 1e-8 relative against the Newton-polished optimum (iterative MLE converged to ~1e-14), logLik 1e-8 (validation/README.md, n = 1182); mlogit's own estimates cross-checked at 1e-6

methods.name: Multinomial logit as nnet::multinom, at the MLE (Newton), with aliasing refused and separation flagged
methods.reference: nnet::multinom(y ~ x1 + x2) on overlapping three-category data, re-solved by Newton's method on the analytic score and information (*_tight); *_pkg = nnet at its default control
quantities: coefficients and SEs per non-reference category
scale-free convergence (x1 x 1e-6, x 1e6; iteration counts agree within one)
methods.tolerance: coefficients Tol::iterative(1e-8), SEs Tol::iterative(1e-6) against the Newton-polished optimum; logLik, AIC Tol::stat(300); coef_pkg Tol::iterative(1e-4) (nnet stops 8.3e-6 off the MLE at its defaults)

methods.name: Count models: outcome domain (MASS, pscl), aliased regressors (glm.nb NA; pscl fails), hurdle zero part = binomial glm
methods.reference: glm(I(y > 0) ~ x1 + x2, binomial) at glm.control(1e-10, 100) = pscl::hurdle zero hurdle; MASS::glm.nb and pscl::{zeroinfl, hurdle} on negative / non-integer counts; glm.nb with an aliased column (T2-WP10's disc_negbin values)
quantities: hurdle zero-part coefficients, SEs, logLik, n, zeros, positives
NB with an aliased column: NA, other coefficients and theta unchanged
methods.tolerance: hurdle zero part at the tight glm fit: coefficients 1e-8, SEs and logLik 1e-6 (glm at R's control also within 1e-8); NB 1e-6 (T2-WP10's tolerance) and 1e-12 against p2a's own fit without the aliased column
